items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: he just walked in one day and said, why don't you do that slap thing with me in the vaudeville? Wanted me to go in vaudeville and join the band.

ctx.x: Cause life was good in Chicago?

And -- so I don't know, I'd done a few things with Paul and so he just walked in one day and said, why don't you do that slap thing with me in the vaudeville? Wanted me to go in vaudeville and join the band. So I just
couldn't talk, really. It was just what I really wanted.
